rules.text: Sika® CarboDur® S plates are pultruded carbon fibre reinforced polymer (CFRP) laminates, designed for strengthening concrete, timber, masonry, steel and fibre reinforced polymer structures
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Sika® CarboDur® S plates are bonded onto the structure as externally bonded reinforcement using Sikadur®-30 epoxy resin based adhesive for normal, or Sikadur 30LP is an epoxy resin based adhesive for elevated temperatures during application and / or service, however lead times and quantities apply
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Sikadur®-30 LP* non stock item lead times apply.
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

rules.text: The system build-up and configuration as described must be fully complied with and may not be changed. Resin adhesive - Sikadur®-30. Structural strengthening Carbon plates – Sika® CarboDur® S. For detailed information on Sikadur®-30, together with the application details, please refer to the Sikadur®-30 Product Data Sheet and the “Method Statement Sika® CarboDur® Externally Bonded Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 05
